latestVersion.changelog:
opencode-controller 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Enables controlling Opencode sessions and workflows via slash commands.
- Guides users through provider selection, authentication, and session management.
- Supports agent switching between planning and building modes.
- Enforces step-by-step planning before any code generation.
- Ensures all actions and choices are explicit in the output.

raw_record.summary: Control and operate Opencode via slash commands. Use this skill to manage sessions, select models, switch agents (plan/build), and coordinate coding through Opencode.
